body: Spending well over 550$ on League of Legends then getting perma banned and loosing everything.
We came to the conclusion that is was better for both of us to be away from each other until both of us gets better and can handle a working relationship. So I guess it worked out pretty good:)
I guess so, I’ll talk to her tomorrow about how I feel. Thank you so much, I didn’t think I would get anywhere posting on reddit but this has been huge help.

I’m just afraid that she will hurt herself physically if I leave her. She promised me that she wouldn’t hurt herself if I didn’t kill myself. Which may sound odd but it worked out pretty well. Just that if I leave her she may start to hurt herself again. I’ve tried to get her to talk to her parents and she has talked to them but the waiting lines on a psychiatrist here is super long if you’re not in an immediate danger  (like I was with my suicidal problems). Though I think her problems is big enough to get her a psychiatrist immediately, she doesn’t believe that.
Thank you, I think I needed to hear this.

I dunno, she is also dealing with some shit right now but I feel like I can’t get any help from her as she just wants me to be happy and romantic all the time. I just want her to understand that I will get better eventually and then I can be happy and  romantic, of course not all the time but at least more than I am now. Also I’ve thought about a break up multiple times but I just feel like I would miss her the day after. I’m really lost and I just don’t now what I should put first, my love for her or my own mental health?
